description: This file defines extension methods for scheduling tasks and actions within the Orleans runtime scheduler, specifically for IGrainContext and WorkItemGroup objects.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Queues a task for execution in the target context's scheduler and returns a Task representing the work.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Queues a task within a WorkItemGroup for a specific target context.

methods.name: QueueAction
methods.description: Queues an action with a state object for execution in the target context's scheduler.

methods.name: RunOrQueueTask
methods.description: Runs the task immediately if the current context matches the target context; otherwise, queues it.
